videos.title: Psalms 94:12-13
videos.description:
Psalm 94:12-13 - Berean Standard Bible
12 Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
13 to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.

videos.title: Psalms 94:11
videos.description:
Psalm 94:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

videos.title: Psalms 94:10
videos.description:
Psalm 94:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?

videos.title: Psalms 94:9
videos.description:
Psalm 94:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?

videos.title: Psalms 94:8
videos.description:
Psalm 94:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?

videos.title: Psalms 94:6-7
videos.description:
Psalm 94:6-7 - Berean Standard Bible
6 They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
7 They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”

videos.title: Psalms 94:4-5
videos.description:
Psalm 94:4-5 - Berean Standard Bible
4 They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
5 They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.

videos.title: Psalms 94:3
videos.description:
Psalm 94:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?

videos.title: Psalms 94:2
videos.description:
Psalm 94:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.

videos.title: Psalms 94:1
videos.description:
Psalm 94:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.

videos.title: Psalms 93:2
videos.description:
Psalm 93:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

videos.title: Psalms 93:5
videos.description:
Psalm 93:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.

videos.title: Psalms 93:4
videos.description:
Psalm 93:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.

videos.title: Psalms 93:3
videos.description:
Psalm 93:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.

videos.title: Psalms 93:1c
videos.description:
Psalm 93:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

videos.title: Psalms 93:2a-b
videos.description:
Psalm 93:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

videos.title: Psalms 92:14-15
videos.description:
Psalm 92:14-15 - Berean Standard Bible
14 In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
15 to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”

videos.title: Psalms 92:12-13
videos.description:
Psalm 92:12-13 - Berean Standard Bible
12 The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
13 Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.

videos.title: Psalms 92:11
videos.description:
Psalm 92:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.

videos.title: Psalms 92:10
videos.description:
Psalm 92:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.

videos.title: Psalms 92:9
videos.description:
Psalm 92:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.

videos.title: Psalms 92:8
videos.description:
Psalm 92:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!

videos.title: Psalms 92:6-7
videos.description:
Psalm 92:6-7 - Berean Standard Bible
6 A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,
7 that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.

videos.title: Psalms 92:5
videos.description:
Psalm 92:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!

videos.title: Psalms 92:4
videos.description:
Psalm 92:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.

videos.title: Psalms 92:1-3
videos.description:
Psalm 92:1-3 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
2 to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
3 with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.

videos.title: Psalms 92:0
videos.description:
Psalm 92:1 - Berean Standard Bible

videos.title: Psalms 91:16
videos.description:
Psalm 91:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”

videos.title: Psalms 91:15
videos.description:
Psalm 91:15 - Berean Standard Bible
15 When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.

videos.title: Psalms 91:14
videos.description:
Psalm 91:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.

videos.title: Psalms 91:13
videos.description:
Psalm 91:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.

videos.title: Psalms 91:11-12
videos.description:
Psalm 91:11-12 - Berean Standard Bible
11 For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
12 They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.

videos.title: Psalms 91:9-10
videos.description:
Psalm 91:9-10 - Berean Standard Bible
9 Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—
10 no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.

videos.title: Psalms 91:10
videos.description:
Psalm 91:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.

videos.title: Psalms 91:7
videos.description:
Psalm 91:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.

videos.title: Psalms 91:5-6
videos.description:
Psalm 91:5-6 - Berean Standard Bible
5 You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
6 nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.

videos.title: Psalms 91:4
videos.description:
Psalm 91:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.

videos.title: Psalms 91:3
videos.description:
Psalm 91:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.

videos.title: Psalms 91:1
videos.description:
Psalm 91:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.

videos.title: Psalms 90:17
videos.description:
Psalm 90:17 - Berean Standard Bible
17 May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!

videos.title: Psalms 90:16
videos.description:
Psalm 90:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.

videos.title: Psalms 90:15
videos.description:
Psalm 90:15 - Berean Standard Bible
15 Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

videos.title: Psalms 90:14
videos.description:
Psalm 90:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

videos.title: Psalms 90:13
videos.description:
Psalm 90:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.

videos.title: Psalms 90:12
videos.description:
Psalm 90:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.

videos.title: Psalms 90:11
videos.description:
Psalm 90:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.

videos.title: Psalms 90:10
videos.description:
Psalm 90:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 The length of our days is seventy years— or eighty if we are strong— yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

videos.title: Psalms 90:9
videos.description:
Psalm 90:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.

videos.title: Psalms 90:8
videos.description:
Psalm 90:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.

videos.title: Psalms 90:7
videos.description:
Psalm 90:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.

videos.title: Psalms 90:5-6
videos.description:
Psalm 90:5-6 - Berean Standard Bible
5 You whisk them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
6 in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.

videos.title: Psalms 90:4
videos.description:
Psalm 90:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.

videos.title: Psalms 90:3
videos.description:
Psalm 90:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”

videos.title: Psalms 90:2
videos.description:
Psalm 90:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.

videos.title: Psalms 90:1
videos.description:
Psalm 90:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.

videos.title: Psalms 89:52
videos.description:
Psalm 89:52 - Berean Standard Bible
52 Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.

videos.title: Psalms 89:50-51
videos.description:
Psalm 89:50-51 - Berean Standard Bible
50 Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people—
51 how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!

videos.title: Psalms 89:49
videos.description:
Psalm 89:49 - Berean Standard Bible
49 Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?

videos.title: Psalms 89:48
videos.description:
Psalm 89:48 - Berean Standard Bible
48 What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah

videos.title: Psalms 89:47
videos.description:
Psalm 89:47 - Berean Standard Bible
47 Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!

videos.title: Psalms 89:46
videos.description:
Psalm 89:46 - Berean Standard Bible
46 How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?

videos.title: Psalms 89:45
videos.description:
Psalm 89:45 - Berean Standard Bible
45 You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 89:44
videos.description:
Psalm 89:44 - Berean Standard Bible
44 You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.

videos.title: Psalms 89:43
videos.description:
Psalm 89:43 - Berean Standard Bible
43 You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.

videos.title: Psalms 89:42
videos.description:
Psalm 89:42 - Berean Standard Bible
42 You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.

videos.title: Psalms 89:41
videos.description:
Psalm 89:41 - Berean Standard Bible
41 All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.

videos.title: Psalms 89:40
videos.description:
Psalm 89:40 - Berean Standard Bible
40 You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.

videos.title: Psalms 89:39
videos.description:
Psalm 89:39 - Berean Standard Bible
39 You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.

videos.title: Psalms 89:38
videos.description:
Psalm 89:38 - Berean Standard Bible
38 Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.

videos.title: Psalms 89:35-37
videos.description:
Psalm 89:35-37 - Berean Standard Bible
35 Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness— I will not lie to David—
36 his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
37 like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah

videos.title: Psalms 89:34
videos.description:
Psalm 89:34 - Berean Standard Bible
34 I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.

videos.title: Psalms 89:33
videos.description:
Psalm 89:33 - Berean Standard Bible
33 But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.

videos.title: Psalms 89:30-32
videos.description:
Psalm 89:30-32 - Berean Standard Bible
30 If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
31 if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
32 I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.

videos.title: Psalms 89:29
videos.description:
Psalm 89:29 - Berean Standard Bible
29 I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

videos.title: Psalms 89:28
videos.description:
Psalm 89:28 - Berean Standard Bible
28 I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.

videos.title: Psalms 89:27
videos.description:
Psalm 89:27 - Berean Standard Bible
27 I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

videos.title: Psalms 89:26
videos.description:
Psalm 89:26 - Berean Standard Bible
26 He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’

videos.title: Psalms 89:25
videos.description:
Psalm 89:25 - Berean Standard Bible
25 I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.

videos.title: Psalms 89:24
videos.description:
Psalm 89:24 - Berean Standard Bible
24 My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.

videos.title: Psalms 89:23
videos.description:
Psalm 89:23 - Berean Standard Bible
23 I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.

videos.title: Psalms 89:22
videos.description:
Psalm 89:22 - Berean Standard Bible
22 No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.

videos.title: Psalms 89:21
videos.description:
Psalm 89:21 - Berean Standard Bible
21 My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.

videos.title: Psalms 89:20
videos.description:
Psalm 89:20 - Berean Standard Bible
20 I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.

videos.title: Psalms 89:19
videos.description:
Psalm 89:19 - Berean Standard Bible
19 You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.

videos.title: Psalms 89:18
videos.description:
Psalm 89:18 - Berean Standard Bible
18 Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.

videos.title: Psalms 89:17
videos.description:
Psalm 89:17 - Berean Standard Bible
17 For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.

videos.title: Psalms 89:16
videos.description:
Psalm 89:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.

videos.title: Psalms 89:15
videos.description:
Psalm 89:15 - Berean Standard Bible
15 Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.

videos.title: Psalms 89:14
videos.description:
Psalm 89:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.

videos.title: Psalms 89:13
videos.description:
Psalm 89:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.

videos.title: Psalms 89:12
videos.description:
Psalm 89:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.

videos.title: Psalms 89:11
videos.description:
Psalm 89:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.

videos.title: Psalms 89:10
videos.description:
Psalm 89:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.

videos.title: Psalms 89:9
videos.description:
Psalm 89:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.

videos.title: Psalms 89:8
videos.description:
Psalm 89:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.

videos.title: Psalms 89:7
videos.description:
Psalm 89:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.

videos.title: Psalms 89:6
videos.description:
Psalm 89:6 - Berean Standard Bible
6 For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?

videos.title: Psalms 89:5
videos.description:
Psalm 89:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.

videos.title: Psalms 89:3-4
videos.description:
Psalm 89:3-4 - Berean Standard Bible
3 You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
4 ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah

videos.title: Psalms 89:2
videos.description:
Psalm 89:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”

18 You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.

videos.description:

17 All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.

videos.title: Psalms 88:16
videos.description:

16 Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.

videos.title: Psalms 88:16
videos.description:
Psalm 88:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.

videos.title: Psalms 88:14
videos.description:
Psalm 88:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?

videos.title: Psalms 88:13
videos.description:
Psalm 88:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.

videos.title: Psalms 88:12
videos.description:
Psalm 88:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?

videos.title: Psalms 88:10
videos.description:
Psalm 88:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah

videos.title: Psalms 88:9
videos.description:

9 My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.

videos.title: Psalms 88:8
videos.description:
Psalm 88:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.

videos.title: Psalms 88:6-7
videos.description:
Psalm 88:6-7 - Berean Standard Bible
6 You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
7 Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 88:5
videos.description:
Psalm 88:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.

videos.title: Psalms 88:5
videos.description:
Psalm 88:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.

videos.title: Psalms 88:4
videos.description:

4 I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.

videos.title: Psalms 88:3
videos.description:

3 For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.

videos.title: Psalms 88:2

2 May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.

5 And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”

4 “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me— along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush — when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”

3 Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah

videos.description:
Psalm 86:17 - Berean Standard Bible
17 Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

videos.title: Psalms 86:16
videos.description:
Psalm 86:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.

videos.title: Psalms 86:15
videos.description:
Psalm 86:15 - Berean Standard Bible
15 But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.

videos.title: Psalms 86:14
videos.description:
Psalm 86:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, with no regard for You.

videos.title: Psalms 86:13
videos.description:
Psalm 86:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

videos.title: Psalms 86:12
videos.description:
Psalm 86:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.

videos.title: Psalms 86:11
videos.description:
Psalm 86:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.

videos.title: Psalms 86:10
videos.description:
Psalm 86:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.

videos.title: Psalms 33:11

6 Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.

videos.title: Psalms 23:2-4
videos.description:
Psalm 23:2-4 - Berean Standard Bible
2 He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
3 He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
4 Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

videos.title: Psalms 22:30-31
videos.description:
Psalm 22:30-31 - Berean Standard Bible
30 Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.
31 They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn— all that He has done.

videos.title: Psalms 22:29
videos.description:
Psalm 22:29 - Berean Standard Bible
29 All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him— even those unable to preserve their lives.

videos.title: Psalms 22:28
videos.description:
Psalm 22:28 - Berean Standard Bible
28 For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.

videos.title: Psalms 22:27
videos.description:
Psalm 22:27 - Berean Standard Bible
27 All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.

videos.title: Psalms 22:26
videos.description:
Psalm 22:26 - Berean Standard Bible
26 The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!

videos.title: Psalms 22:25
videos.description:
Psalm 22:25 - Berean Standard Bible
25 My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.

videos.title: Psalms 22:24
videos.description:
Psalm 22:24 - Berean Standard Bible
24 For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.

videos.title: Psalms 22:23
videos.description:
Psalm 22:23 - Berean Standard Bible
23 You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!

videos.title: Psalms 22:22
videos.description:
Psalm 22:22 - Berean Standard Bible
22 I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.

videos.title: Psalms 22:20-21
videos.description:
Psalm 22:20-21 - Berean Standard Bible
20 Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
21 Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!

videos.title: Psalms 22:16-18
videos.description:
Psalm 22:16-18 - Berean Standard Bible
16 For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.
17 I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
18 They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.

videos.title: Psalms 22:19
videos.description:
Psalm 22:19 - Berean Standard Bible
19 But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.

videos.title: Psalms 22:12-15
videos.description:
Psalm 22:12-15 - Berean Standard Bible
12 Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
13 They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
14 I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.
15 My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.

videos.title: Psalms 22:11
videos.description:
Psalm 22:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

videos.title: Psalms 22:10
videos.description:
Psalm 22:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.

videos.title: Psalms 22:9
videos.description:
Psalm 22:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.

videos.title: Psalms 22:6-8
videos.description:
Psalm 22:6-8 - Berean Standard Bible
6 But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.
7 All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:
8 “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”

videos.title: Psalms 22:5
videos.description:
Psalm 22:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.

videos.title: Psalms 22:4
videos.description:
Psalm 22:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.

videos.title: Psalms 22:3
videos.description:
Psalm 22:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.

videos.title: Psalms 22:2
videos.description:
Psalm 22:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.

Psalm 21:12-13 - Berean Standard Bible
12 For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
13 Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.

videos.title: Psalms 21:11
videos.description:
Psalm 21:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.

videos.title: Psalms 21:10
videos.description:
Psalm 21:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.

videos.title: Psalms 21:8-9
videos.description:
Psalm 21:8-9 - Berean Standard Bible
8 Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
9 You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.

videos.title: Psalms 21:7
videos.description:
Psalm 21:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.

videos.title: Psalms 21:6
videos.description:
Psalm 21:6 - Berean Standard Bible
6 For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.

videos.title: Psalms 21:5
videos.description:
Psalm 21:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.

videos.title: Psalms 21:4
videos.description:
Psalm 21:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.

videos.title: Psalms 21:3
videos.description:
Psalm 21:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.

videos.title: Psalms 20:7

7 Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

videos.title: Psalms 20:6

videos.title: Psalms 20:5

videos.title: Psalms 20:4

Psalm 19:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.

videos.title: Psalms 19:13
videos.description:
Psalm 19:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.

videos.title: Psalms 19:12
videos.description:
Psalm 19:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.

videos.title: Psalms 19:11
videos.description:
Psalm 19:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.

videos.title: Psalms 19:10
videos.description:
Psalm 19:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

videos.title: Psalms 19:9
videos.description:
Psalm 19:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.

videos.title: Psalms 19:7
videos.description:
Psalm 19:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.

videos.title: Psalms 19:5-6

5 Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
6 it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.

videos.title: Psalms 18:50
videos.description:
Psalm 18:50 - Berean Standard Bible
50 Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.

videos.title: Psalms 18:46-48a
videos.description:
Psalm 18:46-48 - Berean Standard Bible
46 The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted—
47 the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,
48 who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.

videos.title: Psalms 18:44-45
videos.description:
Psalm 18:44-45 - Berean Standard Bible
44 When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
45 Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.

videos.title: Psalms 18:43
videos.description:
Psalm 18:43 - Berean Standard Bible
43 You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.

videos.title: Psalms 18:42
videos.description:
Psalm 18:42 - Berean Standard Bible
42 I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.

videos.title: Psalms 18:41
videos.description:
Psalm 18:41 - Berean Standard Bible
41 They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.

videos.title: Psalms 18:40
videos.description:
Psalm 18:40 - Berean Standard Bible
40 You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.

videos.title: Psalms 18:39
videos.description:
Psalm 18:39 - Berean Standard Bible
39 You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.

videos.title: Psalms 18:38
videos.description:
Psalm 18:38 - Berean Standard Bible
38 I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.

videos.title: Psalms 18:36-37
videos.description:
Psalm 18:36-37 - Berean Standard Bible
36 You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
37 I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.

videos.title: Psalms 18:35
videos.description:
Psalm 18:35 - Berean Standard Bible
35 You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.

videos.title: Psalms 18:34
videos.description:
Psalm 18:34 - Berean Standard Bible
34 He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

videos.title: Psalms 18:33
videos.description:
Psalm 18:33 - Berean Standard Bible
33 He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.

videos.title: Psalms 18:32
videos.description:
Psalm 18:32 - Berean Standard Bible
32 It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.

videos.title: Psalms 18:31
videos.description:
Psalm 18:31 - Berean Standard Bible
31 For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?

videos.title: Psalms 18:30
videos.description:
Psalm 18:30 - Berean Standard Bible
30 As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.

videos.title: Psalms 18:29
videos.description:
Psalm 18:29 - Berean Standard Bible
29 For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.

videos.title: Psalms 18:28
videos.description:
Psalm 18:28 - Berean Standard Bible
28 For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.

videos.title: Psalms 18:25-27
videos.description:
Psalm 18:25-27 - Berean Standard Bible
25 To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
26 to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
27 For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.

videos.title: Psalms 18:24
videos.description:
Psalm 18:24 - Berean Standard Bible
24 So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.

videos.title: Psalms 18:23
videos.description:
Psalm 18:23 - Berean Standard Bible
23 And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.

videos.title: Psalms 18:22
videos.description:
Psalm 18:22 - Berean Standard Bible
22 For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.

videos.title: Psalms 18:21
videos.description:
Psalm 18:21 - Berean Standard Bible
21 For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.

videos.title: Psalms 18:20
videos.description:
Psalm 18:20 - Berean Standard Bible
20 The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.

videos.title: Psalms 18:19
videos.description:
Psalm 18:19 - Berean Standard Bible
19 He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.

videos.title: Psalms 18:18
videos.description:
Psalm 18:18 - Berean Standard Bible
18 They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.

videos.title: Psalms 18:17
videos.description:
Psalm 18:17 - Berean Standard Bible
17 He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.

videos.title: Psalms 18:16
videos.description:
Psalm 18:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.

videos.title: Psalms 18:15
videos.description:
Psalm 18:15 - Berean Standard Bible
15 The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at Your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.

videos.title: Psalms 18:14
videos.description:
Psalm 18:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.

videos.title: Psalms 18:13
videos.description:
Psalm 18:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded— hailstones and coals of fire.

videos.title: Psalms 18:12
videos.description:
Psalm 18:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced— hailstones and coals of fire.

videos.title: Psalms 18:11
videos.description:
Psalm 18:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 He made darkness His hiding place, and storm clouds a canopy around Him.

videos.title: Psalms 18:10
videos.description:
Psalm 18:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.

videos.title: Psalms 18:9
videos.description:
Psalm 18:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.

videos.title: Psalms 18:8
videos.description:
Psalm 18:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.

videos.title: Psalms 18:7
videos.description:
Psalm 18:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.

videos.title: Psalms 18:4-6
videos.description:
Psalm 18:4-6 - Berean Standard Bible
4 The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
5 The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
6 In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.

videos.title: Psalms 18:1-3
videos.description:
Psalm 18:1-3 - Berean Standard Bible
1 For the choirmaster. Of David the servant of the LORD, who sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love You, O LORD, my strength.
2 The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
3 I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.

videos.title: Psalms 18:0

videos.title: Psalms 17:13-14
videos.description:
Psalm 17:13-14 - Berean Standard Bible
13 Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,
14 from such men, O LORD, by Your hand— from men of the world whose portion is in this life. May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons, so they leave their abundance to their children.

videos.title: Psalms 17:10-12
videos.description:
Psalm 17:10-12 - Berean Standard Bible
10 They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.
11 They have tracked us down, and now surround us; their eyes are set to cast us to the ground,
12 like a lion greedy for prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush.

videos.title: Psalms 17:8-9
videos.description:
Psalm 17:8-9 - Berean Standard Bible
8 Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
9 from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.

videos.title: Psalms 17:7
videos.description:
Psalm 17:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.

videos.title: Psalms 17:6
videos.description:
Psalm 17:6 - Berean Standard Bible
6 I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.

videos.title: Psalms 17:5
videos.description:
Psalm 17:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.

videos.title: Psalm 17:4
videos.description:
Psalm 17:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 As for the deeds of men— by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.

videos.title: Psalms 17:3
videos.description:
Psalm 17:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.

videos.title: Psalms 17:1-2
videos.description:
Psalm 17:1-2 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A prayer of David. Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.
2 May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.

videos.title: Psalms 16:11
videos.description:
Psalm 16:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.

videos.title: Psalms 17:0
videos.description:
Psalm 17:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A prayer of David. Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.

videos.title: Psalms 16:10
videos.description:
Psalm 16:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.

videos.title: Psalms 16:9
videos.description:
Psalm 16:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.

videos.title: Psalms 16:8
videos.description:
Psalm 16:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

videos.title: Psalms 16:7
videos.description:
Psalm 16:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.

videos.title: Psalms 16:6
videos.description:
Psalm 16:6 - Berean Standard Bible
6 The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.

videos.title: Psalms 16:5
videos.description:
Psalm 16:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.

5 But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
6 I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.

videos.title: Psalms 13:3-4
videos.description:
Psalm 13:3-4 - Berean Standard Bible
3 Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
4 lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I fall.

Psalm 13:1-2 - Berean Standard Bible

7 You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.
8 The wicked wander freely, and vileness is exalted among men.

videos.title: Psalms 12:5-6

Psalm 12:5-6 - Berean Standard Bible
5 “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”
6 The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.

videos.title: Psalms 12:3-4
videos.description:
Psalm 12:3-4 - Berean Standard Bible
3 May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue.
4 They say, “With our tongues we will prevail. We own our lips—who can be our master?”

videos.title: Psalms 12:1-2

Psalm 12:1-2 - Berean Standard Bible

7 For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.

5 The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.
6 On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind will be their portion.

4 The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.

videos.title: Psalms 10:16-18
videos.description:
Psalm 10:16-18 - Berean Standard Bible
16 The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
17 You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,
18 to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.

videos.title: Psalms 10:14-15
videos.description:
Psalm 10:14-15 - Berean Standard Bible
14 But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
15 Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.

videos.title: Psalms 10:12-13
videos.description:
Psalm 10:12-13 - Berean Standard Bible
12 Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.
13 Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”

videos.title: Psalms 10:9-11
videos.description:
Psalm 10:9-11 - Berean Standard Bible
9 He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.
10 They are crushed and beaten down; the hapless fall prey to his strength.
11 He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”

videos.title: Psalms 10:7-8
videos.description:
Psalm 10:7-8 - Berean Standard Bible
7 His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
8 He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.

videos.title: Psalms 10:5-6
videos.description:
Psalm 10:5-6 - Berean Standard Bible
5 He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.
6 He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”

videos.title: Psalms 10:3-4
videos.description:
Psalm 10:3-4 - Berean Standard Bible
3 For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
4 In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.

videos.title: Psalms 10:1-2
videos.description:
Psalm 10:1-2 - Berean Standard Bible
1 Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?
2 In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.

videos.title: Psalms 9:19-20
videos.description:
Psalm 9:19-20 - Berean Standard Bible
19 Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.
20 Lay terror upon them, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 9:17-18
videos.description:
Psalm 9:17-18 - Berean Standard Bible
17 The wicked will return to Sheol— all the nations who forget God.
18 For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.

videos.title: Psalms 9:15-16
videos.description:
Psalm 9:15-16 - Berean Standard Bible
15 The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
16 The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah

videos.title: Psalms 9:7-10
videos.description:
Psalm 9:7-10 - Berean Standard Bible
7 But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
8 He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
9 The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
10 Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.

videos.title: Psalms 9:6
videos.description:
Psalm 9:6 - Berean Standard Bible
6 The enemy has come to eternal ruin, and You have uprooted their cities; the very memory of them has vanished.

videos.title: Psalms 9:5
videos.description:
Psalm 9:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.

videos.title: Psalms 9:3-4
videos.description:
Psalm 9:3-4 - Berean Standard Bible
3 When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
4 For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.

videos.title: Psalms 9:0
videos.description:
Psalm 9:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm of David. I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.

videos.title: Psalms 8:6-9
videos.description:
Psalm 8:6-9 - Berean Standard Bible
6 You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
7 all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,
8 the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
9 O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!

videos.title: Psalms 8:3-4
videos.description:
Psalm 8:3-4 - Berean Standard Bible
3 When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—
4 what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?

videos.title: Psalms 8:1-2
videos.description:
Psalm 8:1-2 - Berean Standard Bible
1 For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
2 From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.

videos.title: Psalms 8:0
videos.description:

videos.title: Psalms 7:14-17
videos.description:
Psalm 7:14-17 - Berean Standard Bible
14 Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
15 He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
16 His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.
17 I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

videos.title: Psalms 7:8-9
videos.description:
Psalm 7:8-9 - Berean Standard Bible
8 The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.
9 Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.

videos.title: Psalms 7:6-7
videos.description:
Psalm 7:6-7 - Berean Standard Bible
6 Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.
7 Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.

videos.title: Psalms 7:3-5
videos.description:
Psalm 7:3-5 - Berean Standard Bible
3 O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands,
4 if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause,
5 then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah

Psalm 7:1-2 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite. O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers,
2 or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

Psalm 6:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.

Psalm 6:6-9 - Berean Standard Bible
6 I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
7 My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
8 Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
9 The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.

videos.title: Psalms 6:4-5
videos.description:
Psalm 6:4-5 - Berean Standard Bible
4 Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
5 For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?

videos.description:
Psalm 5:11-12 - Berean Standard Bible
11 But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
12 For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.

videos.title: Psalms 5:10
videos.description:
Psalm 5:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.

videos.title: Psalms 5:8-9
videos.description:
Psalm 5:8-9 - Berean Standard Bible
8 Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
9 For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.

videos.title: Psalms 5:4-6
videos.description:
Psalm 5:4-6 - Berean Standard Bible
4 For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.
5 The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
6 You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.

videos.title: Psalms 5:3
videos.description:
Psalm 5:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.

videos.title: Psalms 5:1-2
videos.description:
Psalm 5:1-2 - Berean Standard Bible
1 For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
2 Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.

videos.title: Psalms 5:0

videos.description:
Psalm 4:5-8 - Berean Standard Bible
5 Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.
6 Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
7 You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
8 I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.

videos.title: Psalms 4:3-4
videos.description:
Psalm 4:3-4 - Berean Standard Bible
3 Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.
4 Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 4:2
videos.description:
Psalm 4:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies ? Selah

videos.title: Psalms 4:1
videos.description:
Psalm 4:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.

videos.title: Psalms 3:7-8
videos.description:
Psalm 3:7-8 - Berean Standard Bible
7 Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
8 Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 3:5-6
videos.description:
Psalm 3:5-6 - Berean Standard Bible
5 I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
6 I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.

videos.title: Psalms 3:3-4
videos.description:
Psalm 3:3-4 - Berean Standard Bible
3 But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
4 To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 3:1-2
videos.description:
Psalm 3:1-2 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A Psalms of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!
2 Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah

videos.title: Psalms 2:10-12
videos.description:
Psalm 2:10-12 - Berean Standard Bible
10 Therefore be wise, O kings; be admonished, O judges of the earth.
11 Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
12 Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.

videos.title: Psalms 2:7-9
videos.description:
Psalm 2:7-9 - Berean Standard Bible
7 I will proclaim the decree spoken to Me by the LORD: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.
8 Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.
9 You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery.”

videos.title: Psalms 2:4-6
videos.description:
Psalm 2:4-6 - Berean Standard Bible
4 The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them.
5 Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury:
6 “I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”

videos.title: Psalms 2:1-3
videos.description:
Psalm 2:1-3 - Berean Standard Bible
1 Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
2 The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:
3 “Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.”

videos.title: Psalms 1:4-6
videos.description:
Psalm 1:4-6 - Berean Standard Bible
4 Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
5 Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
6 For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.

videos.title: Psalms 1:3
videos.description:
Psalm 1:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.

videos.title: Psalms 1:2
videos.description:
Psalm 1:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.

videos.title: Psalms 1:1
videos.description:
Psalm 1:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
